name: smwsprites-flashing-32x32-door
title: Flashing 32x32 Door
description:
A simple 32x32 door sprite that flashes 1 or 2 extra sprite tiles as a way to warn or inform the player of what it does. Has gravity and object interaction so that you can use it in puzzles. Customizable:

- If the extra bit is set, a specific level number is used instead of the regular screen exit
- Uncommon RAM adresses can be changed to avoid conflicts
- Totally customizable sound-wise
- Timer animation allows for 9 different values
- Has an option to flash its tile(s) only if Mario is close to it, with customizable distance check

Basic graphics included.
Details in .asm file

Requested by Gi Manilla.
